description: Dual low-power operational amplifier, single-supply capable. DIP-8.

chunks.title: Component Overview
chunks.text: [Component context: LM358] Dual operational amplifier. Operates from a single supply of 3 V to 32 V, or dual supplies of plus/minus 1.5 V to plus/minus 16 V. Absolute maximum supply voltage is 32 V. Low input bias current, internally frequency compensated for unity gain. Package DIP-8.

chunks.title: Pinout
chunks.text: [Component context: LM358] Pinout (DIP-8): pin 1 OUT1, pin 2 IN1-, pin 3 IN1+, pin 4 GND/V-, pin 5 IN2+, pin 6 IN2-, pin 7 OUT2, pin 8 VCC/V+.
